observations: Photo shows a DSLR-style camera body with 'Nikon' clearly printed on the front.
A matching lens is attached with 'Nikon' visible on its cap, plus a separate detached lens lying beside the body.
No model number is legible on the camera body or lenses in this photo.
No visible screen-on, battery, or memory card to confirm working state.
Camera and lenses appear physically intact and cosmetically clean.

claims.evidence: photo 0 shows 'Nikon' printed on both the camera body and the lens cap, not Canon
Two lenses are visible in photo 0, but no focal length markings are legible on either

claims.claim: Clean and good to shoot videos and snapshots
claims.evidence: No power-on, test shot, or video sample shown; functional state cannot be judged from a static photo

risks.risk: Brand mismatch between seller's text (Canon) and photo evidence (Nikon) suggests misrepresentation, wrong listing, or swapped photos.
risks.proof: A clear photo or video of the camera powered on showing the brand/model menu screen, matching the body badge
risks.if_unproven: treated as unverified identity, priced at the low end of the generic category until resolved

risks.risk: Sensor, shutter count, or internal function (autofocus, video recording) could be faulty.
risks.proof: A power-on video showing live view, a test photo/video sample, and shutter count via menu
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working / worst case

risks.risk: Lens focal lengths (18-55mm and 50mm) are unproven since no markings are visible.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of each lens barrel showing the focal length and brand engraving
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown/generic kit lenses, not premium primes

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card (needed for actual use) are not shown.
risks.proof: A photo of the full accessory bundle including battery, charger, and card
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lenses only, no accessories

proof_requests: Photo of the camera powered on showing brand/model on the LCD or viewfinder menu
Close-up photos of each lens barrel showing engraved focal length and brand
A short video of the camera in use (zoom, autofocus, shutter sound) to confirm function
Photo of included accessories: battery, charger, memory card, strap
response.reason: The seller claims the camera is a Canon, but the photo clearly shows Nikon branding on both the body and lens, a direct contradiction that raises concern about misrepresentation or a mismatched listing.
